facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Capital Type: No Guaranteed Capital; separate venture funding decision
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Current 2026 program does not guarantee venture funding; investors including Ripple assess startups individually after program. Prior XRPL cohorts have used milestone-based non-dilutive grants, but this should not be assumed for SFIIP 2026.
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Separate post-program investment decision; any offer is optional to accept
facts_raw.Non-dilutive: Program participation itself: Yes / no equity commitment
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Joining does not require giving equity. Any later venture investment has separate negotiated terms.
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No; pre-incorporation small teams may apply. Incorporated entity required to access later venture funding.
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Applicant must be 18+ and not be a citizen of / located in OFAC-sanctioned territory.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Build on or clearly plan to build on XRPL; at least MVP or clear roadmap; strong technical foundations; validated problem/market opportunity.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Mostly virtual; demo week expected on-site for full benefit
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Predominantly virtual/hybrid; fixed program elements ≤3h/week; end-of-program on-site demo week is expected.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: ~15-min application with product, traction, organization; pitch deck optional/preferred; GitHub repo recommended/should be accessible.
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI / AI-native；Fintech；Crypto / Web3；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
